name: Breaker-and-a-half middle-bay interface
summary: Identifies the shared middle-breaker connections within the assigned diameter.
description: Identifies the shared middle-breaker connections within the assigned diameter. A bay circuit arrangement groups the switching, measuring and protection interfaces associated with a specific network circuit. A line bay, transformer bay and reactor bay share some devices but connect different kinds of primary equipment.

In a switchyard single-line drawing, the bay arrangement helps the reader follow the circuit from its bus connection to the external line, transformer or compensation equipment and identify the measurement boundaries along the path. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Two diameter circuits” at the input and “Middle-breaker interface” at the output. Shared breaker failure affects both associated circuits.
